title: Restic: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116586)
description: A security vulnerability affects the restic package due to its use of Go JOSE, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability impacts versions of restic prior to 0.18.1-r13. A fix is available in version 0.18.1-r13. The CVSS 4.0 base score is 6.9, indicating a medium severity level.
